liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer finds the original 1969 composition and sound of this song fascinating [16]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls this performance the best version of the song [9]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Reviewer believes this is the best performance of the song [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.fixed.cribbs.28297.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 164 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the sound quality as great and stellar; Reviewer calls it a remarkable recording for the period [9][18]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.98968.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 4.75/5 by 20 [2]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.barry.patched-fixed.98927.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.88501.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording quality as amazing for the 1969 set list; Reviewer notes the recording brings a foot boogie and head bop [14][15]
- **gd1969-04-23.partial.sbd.gems.98793.flac24**: soundboard; 6 songs; 47 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes Garcia's Gibson SG sound as fat and alive; Reviewer rates sound quality somewhat less than excellent, suggesting cleanup [16][17]

## Around the show

- Attendees report the band distributed peanut butter and jelly sandwiches [10]
- MC called the band the best rock and roll band in the world [11]
- Reviewer says the show sounds like it was lots of fun [18]
- Second set sequence differed from the standard 1969 Dark Star to Eleven jam [12]
- First set song meshing was different and enjoyable to the reviewer [12]
- Reviewer considers this the best available version of the show [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.fixed.cribbs.28297.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: MSR>C>D>CD (fix of http://db.etree.org/shninfo_detail.php?shnid=70) [1]. Also: Uploader crossfaded splice between St. Stephen and It's A Sin; Uploader removed 27 seconds from the Cryptical Envelopment Reprise [1]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.98968.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [2]. Also: Cut between St. Stephen and It's A Sin patched with shn 98793; Joe B. Jones helped pitch correct the patch source [2][19]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.barry.patched-fixed.98927.flac16**: transferred by Monte Barry; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: New source was speed corrected, dehissed, and repatched; Charlie Miller provided speed error spec and disc overburn data [3]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.88501.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D [4]. Also: Reviewer chose this version because it is a Charlie Miller transfer [14]
- **gd1969-04-23.partial.sbd.gems.98793.flac24**: source: SBD -> ? -> Cassette -> gen1 cassette [7]
